posts.author: Solarae
posts.body:
I'm relatively new to RPG Maker MV (I previously used RPG Maker 2003), and I've run into an issue I can't figure out.
The Issue:
Player characters deal normal damage to enemies, and their damage increases correctly when leveling. However,
all enemies deal 0 damage to player characters
, even a basic Level 1 test boss I created.
Attack Formula:
The enemy's attack skill uses the default MV physical damage formula:
a.atk * 4 - b.def * 2
Despite this, enemy attacks always calculate to
0 damage
.
What I've Tried:
Increasing the enemy's
LUK
to 30. This made the enemy barely damage the player once, but I don't think Luck should affect base damage like that.
Confirmed there are
no states, buffs/debuffs, or immortality traits
on actors.
No plugins installed.
Setup Details:
Actors start at
Level 1
Actors currently
have no armor equipped
I've attached screenshots of the enemy stats and setup. I'm guessing I'm overlooking something simple in the database or formula, but I'm not sure what.
Any help would be appreciated.
Update: All enemies, even basic ones dont hit. Using the same attack formula and player is lv1.

you havent shown what your actor's lv1 parameters are supposed to be when testing. what are they? is the DEF lower than 40?
with the default damage formula, if your actor has twice your enemy's ATK or greater as their DEF, the enemy isnt going to be able to deal any damage without buffs/debuffs.
